exams.name: AWS Certified Advanced Networking - Specialty
exams.blurb: Specialty exam on hybrid and complex AWS networking including Direct Connect, Transit Gateway and VPC design; AWS has scheduled it for retirement in 2026.

exams.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
exams.blurb: Foundational AWS credential covering artificial intelligence, machine learning and generative AI concepts plus Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker services.

exams.name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
exams.blurb: Entry-level AWS certification covering cloud concepts, core services, security, pricing and support models for technical and non-technical candidates.

exams.name: AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer - Associate
exams.blurb: Operations-focused associate exam on deploying, monitoring and troubleshooting AWS workloads; it replaced the SysOps Administrator exam in late 2025.

exams.name: AWS Certified Data Analytics - Specialty
exams.blurb: Retired in April 2024 and superseded by the Data Engineer Associate exam, this specialty covered Kinesis, Redshift, Glue and analytics pipeline design.

exams.name: AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on building and operating AWS data pipelines with Glue, Athena, Redshift, Kinesis and EMR, including data governance and quality.

exams.name: AWS Certified Database - Specialty
exams.blurb: Retired by AWS in April 2024, this specialty exam covered Aurora, RDS, DynamoDB and database migration design and remains a widely searched credential.

exams.name: AWS Certified Developer - Associate
exams.blurb: Associate-level exam for developers building on AWS with Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SDKs, CI/CD tooling and application security practices.

exams.name: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional
exams.blurb: Professional-level exam on continuous delivery, infrastructure as code, monitoring, incident response and automation across AWS environments.

exams.name: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional
exams.blurb: Professional exam introduced in late 2025 covering production generative AI on AWS including Bedrock agents, RAG pipelines, guardrails and vector stores.

exams.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty
exams.blurb: Long-running AWS machine learning specialty exam covering data engineering, modelling and deployment; AWS set 31 March 2026 as the final test date.

exams.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on building, deploying and operating machine learning workloads with SageMaker, replacing the ML Specialty as the default AWS ML credential.

exams.name: AWS Certified Security - Specialty
exams.blurb: Specialty exam on AWS incident response, logging, identity management, data protection and infrastructure security; SCS-C03 replaced SCS-C02 in 2025.

exams.name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate
exams.blurb: The most widely held AWS certification, covering resilient, secure, high-performing and cost-optimised architecture design on AWS.

exams.name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional
exams.blurb: Professional exam on complex multi-account, multi-region AWS architecture, migration strategy, cost control and continuous improvement.

exams.name: AWS Certified SysOps Administrator - Associate
exams.blurb: Retired on 29 September 2025 and replaced by the CloudOps Engineer Associate exam, it covered deployment, monitoring and operations of AWS workloads.

exams.name: AWS Certified: SAP on AWS - Specialty
exams.blurb: Retired in April 2024, this specialty validated designing, migrating and operating SAP workloads such as S/4HANA on AWS infrastructure.

exams.name: Certified Argo Project Associate
exams.blurb: CNCF associate exam covering the Argo ecosystem including Argo CD, Argo Workflows, Argo Rollouts and Argo Events for GitOps delivery on Kubernetes.

exams.name: Certified Backstage Associate
exams.blurb: CNCF associate certification on the Backstage developer portal covering software catalogues, templates, TechDocs, plugins and platform engineering basics.

exams.name: Certified Cilium Associate
exams.blurb: CNCF associate exam on Cilium eBPF-based networking, network policy, service mesh and observability with Hubble in Kubernetes clusters.

exams.name: Certified Cloud Native Platform Engineering Associate
exams.blurb: CNCF associate certification on platform engineering practice, internal developer platforms, golden paths, GitOps delivery and measuring platform value.

exams.name: Certified GitOps Associate
exams.blurb: CNCF associate exam covering GitOps principles, declarative configuration, reconciliation, drift detection and secrets handling in continuous delivery.

exams.name: Certified Kubernetes Administrator
exams.blurb: Hands-on performance-based exam on installing, configuring and operating production Kubernetes clusters, including networking, storage and troubleshooting.

exams.name: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer
exams.blurb: Performance-based CNCF exam on designing, building and deploying cloud-native applications to Kubernetes using pods, config, services and observability.

exams.name: Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist
exams.blurb: Advanced hands-on CNCF exam on Kubernetes cluster hardening, supply chain security, runtime security and monitoring; requires a current CKA.

exams.name: Istio Certified Associate
exams.blurb: CNCF associate exam on the Istio service mesh covering traffic management, resilience, security policy, observability and mesh installation.

exams.name: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate
exams.blurb: Entry-level CNCF exam covering Kubernetes architecture, container orchestration basics, cloud-native observability, delivery and the CNCF ecosystem.

exams.name: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Security Associate
exams.blurb: CNCF associate exam on Kubernetes security fundamentals including the 4C model, threat modelling, platform hardening and compliance frameworks.

exams.name: Kyverno Certified Associate
exams.blurb: CNCF associate exam on Kyverno policy-as-code for Kubernetes, covering validation, mutation, generation rules, policy reporting and image verification.

exams.name: OpenTelemetry Certified Associate
exams.blurb: CNCF associate exam covering OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, instrumentation, the Collector, semantic conventions and observability pipelines.

exams.name: Prometheus Certified Associate
exams.blurb: CNCF associate exam on Prometheus monitoring covering PromQL, exporters, alerting rules, Alertmanager, service discovery and instrumentation.

exams.name: HashiCorp Certified: Consul Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on HashiCorp Consul service discovery, service mesh, health checking, key-value configuration and multi-datacentre federation.

exams.name: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
exams.blurb: Widely held infrastructure-as-code certification covering Terraform workflow, state management, modules, providers and HCP Terraform collaboration.

exams.name: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Authoring and Operations Professional
exams.blurb: Hands-on professional exam requiring candidates to write, refactor and operate Terraform configurations and modules in a live lab environment.

exams.name: HashiCorp Certified: Vault Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on HashiCorp Vault secrets management, authentication methods, policies, dynamic credentials, encryption as a service and tokens.

exams.name: HashiCorp Certified: Vault Operations Professional
exams.blurb: Lab-based professional exam on deploying, monitoring and troubleshooting production Vault clusters including replication, seals and disaster recovery.

exams.name: SUSE Certified Administrator in SUSE Linux Enterprise Server
exams.blurb: SUSE certification covering SUSE Linux Enterprise Server installation, YaST and Zypper administration, storage, networking and system services.

exams.name: SUSE Certified Engineer in SUSE Linux Enterprise Server
exams.blurb: Advanced SUSE certification on enterprise Linux deployment, automation with AutoYaST and Salt, high availability, security and troubleshooting.
